divergences.description: Spec 4.2 Intent says the badge derivation computes each card's badge from Entry.serverRevision/updatedAt plus the matching pending-write status. The implemented deriveSyncBadgeState() ignores the entry's fields completely: it returns synchronized whenever no pending write exists, and only the pending write's status matters otherwise.
